answer: Because the timing is written down against the ocean challenge, the reef audit can replay the yarrow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 123 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2497 identities would post 2132 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
